angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 26,923,590 km at 1248.20 pc = 0.29 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RY CMa: Baade-Wesselink distance (pc) 1248.2 +/- 99.5 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 1248.2 +/- 99.5 pc; Gaia DR3 parallax 0.8006 +/- 0.0291 mas (same row, RUWE 1.29), 27.5 standard errors, is not used
radiusSource: Radius 38.7 +/- 3.1 solar radii from Groenewegen (2013), A&A 550, A70, table10, RY CMa: Baade-Wesselink mean radius (solar radii) 38.7 +/- 3.1 (Monte-Carlo) (https://arxiv.org/abs/1212.5478): 26,923,590 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. No mass is measured, so GM is 0, the records' unpublished value. Temperature 5625 +/- 153 K from Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 141, Name='RY CMa', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: Groenewegen (2020), A&A 635, A33, VizieR J/A+A/635/A33/table1, recno 141, Name='RY CMa', columns Teff, e_Teff (K): Teff 5625 +/- 153 K from a fit to the spectral energy distribution at mean light (not spectroscopic) (https://arxiv.org/abs/2002.02186)
surfaceGravitySource: log g 1.42 from 2024A&A...690A.246T, the median of its 2 spectra; the 7 published values span log g 1.2 to 2.1, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.7% of the centre brightness (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2024A%26A...690A.246T)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, coloured from a blackbody at the star's published temperature (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
